provenance.basis: The L298 accepts standard TTL logic; ViH is specified at 2.3 V minimum. Hardware Splicer conservatively bounds the normal module logic-input ceiling to its 5 V logic rail.

provenance.document_section: Logic-level feature; RDS(on) characterized at VGS = 4.5 V
provenance.basis: Hardware Splicer only treats 4.5-5.0 V as a guaranteed normal control-drive window for the catalog module. The device is logic-level and allows higher VGS, but a blanket 3.3 V low-resistance guarantee is not promoted from human catalog prose.
